title: Pure Cloudian
summary: Pure Cloudian control and swarm build with Toadally Awesome, generic staples, and an automatic Extra Deck. Cloudians are WATER Fairies that cannot be destroyed by battle (though they self-destruct if placed in face-up Defense Position) and generate Fog Counters on Normal Summon to fuel repeatable removal and summons.

summary.title: Starters
points: Cloudian Aerosol discards a Cloudian to place Fog Counters equal to its Level on any face-up monster on the field, then banishes itself and a Cloudian from the GY on a later turn to Special Summon any Cloudian from the Deck.

Cloudian - Turbulence gains Fog Counters on Normal Summon and removes 1 Fog Counter from anywhere on the field (with no once-per-turn limit) to Special Summon Cloudian - Smoke Ball from the Deck or either GY.
Cloudian - Storm Dragon Special Summons itself from the hand by banishing a Cloudian from the GY and places a Fog Counter on a monster each turn.

summary.title: Opening: Cloudian - Turbulence + Cloudian Aerosol
steps: Normal Summon Cloudian - Turbulence, placing 1 Fog Counter on it, and spend that counter to Special Summon Cloudian - Smoke Ball from the Deck.
Activate Cloudian Aerosol, discarding a Level 4 Cloudian to place 4 Fog Counters on Turbulence.

Spend Fog Counters from Turbulence to summon the remaining copies of Cloudian - Smoke Ball from the Deck or GY, drawing 2 cards at the End Phase if Lucky Cloud is active, and use the bodies for Link or Xyz plays.

summary.title: Fog Counter Control
points: Cloudian - Cirrostratus removes 2 Fog Counters to target and destroy a monster on the field.
Cloudian - Acid Cloud removes 2 Fog Counters to target and destroy a Spell or Trap.
Cloudian - Altus removes 3 Fog Counters from anywhere on the field to discard a random card from the opponent's hand.
Cloudian - Nimbusman can Tribute any number of WATER monsters for its Tribute Summon, places a Fog Counter for each, and gains 500 ATK for every Fog Counter on the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Extra Deck
points: Toadally Awesome provides a Quick Effect omni-negate that sets the negated card to your field and recycles a WATER monster when sent to the GY.

Cloudian - Sheep Cloud floats into 2 Cloudian Tokens in Defense Position when destroyed by battle, and Cloudian - Poison Cloud destroys the monster that destroyed it while face-down and burns for 800.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Summon Cloud Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Cloudian from the hand or GY while you control no monsters (destroying itself if you summon from the GY).

Fog Control Tributes a face-up Cloudian as a Quick-Play to place 3 Fog Counters on a monster, and Lucky Cloud draws 2 cards during the End Phase of a turn you summoned two Cloudians with the same name.
Rain Storm reduces a Cloudian's ATK by 1000 or 2000 to destroy 1 Spell/Trap or 2 cards the opponent controls.
